concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-cash-out-instantly-cashout-request]] — 2020-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Marketplace `/cashouts` request guide for pending-balance availability, optional instrument payout and fee, capability/route checks, asynchronous webhooks and failure reversal; request/response examples conflict on instrument placement and fee amount.
warnings: A cashout can make pending funds available on a user balance account without paying out to a bank; optional instrument payout is a separate asynchronous outcome.

The example curl uses top-level transferInstrumentId although the field table requires counterparty.transferInstrumentId; response fee amount also conflicts with prose/request and cashoutFee transfer.
